historical_references.reference: Arnavansh was an esteemed title given to the rulers of the Chandela dynasty in Central India during the 10th and 11th centuries CE.
Arnavansh is also mentioned in the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata, as an ancestor of Bhishma Pitamaha, a central character in the epic.
